author: reek
body: Probe (closed by capability stage 1a): the raw port intrinsics now carry the Device.Port effect row, so a function with a pure signature (no effect annotation) can no longer drive a hardware I/O port. In an application/library quire the effect is enforced - the effectful call cannot hide in a plain let (CDX2033) and port-in-byte's effect is not declared in the signature (CDX2031). The owned hardware stack (compiler, kernel, boards, plugs) is quire-exempt; foreword and apps, like this one, must declare.
